title: The text and movements of Colors
summary: The text is in the program, not sung, and Lewis cannot recall the movement titles.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: We can return to Colors: the Ecology of Oneness. You mentioned that there was a text. Is it a sung text? Or is it recitation in there?
Oh, no, no. That’s in the program.
Are there any subtitles or titles of the eight movements in there that also reflect this.
Yes, that I don’t remember. You write something, and you wrote it, and then you move on. If I had known that you wanted it this moment, I would have gotten it and had it available.
